snippet.description:
Ed Sheeran’s tour is facing a major shakeup after Macklemore was removed from the remaining US dates following pro-Palestinian comments onstage.

Now, several other opening artists are walking away from the tour in solidarity — putting Sheeran at the center of a larger debate over political speech, artistic freedom, and whether major artists can truly remain apolitical.
